grid.projection: South polar stereographic, planetocentric, 0° east meridian up, 1737400 m sphere
grid.registration: Pixel centers; rows run down; bounds match the bundled LOLA DEM derivative
grid.format: 6 bytes per cell, little endian: uint16 peak (0.1 K), uint16 mean (0.1 K), uint8 populated bins, uint8 shadow count out of 64. Missing uint16=65535 or uint8=255.

thermal.files: Pinned polar_south_96x2 downloads; internal title says 24x6 so no sampling denominator is used
thermal.method: Peak is max over the intersecting 3×3 source cells; mean is weighted by projected overlap area; sampling is the minimum populated-bin count. Missing input in a stencil propagates.
thermal.limits: The source axes are converted from lunar-radius units to meters. Assumed alignment with DE421, no independently fitted registration. Values are climatological and include inferred time bins. Minimum, instant and hardware temperatures are unavailable.

shadow.representation: Modeled permanent shadow from LOLA terrain and illumination geometry
shadow.citation: Mazarico et al. (2011), NASA PDS LPSR_85S_060M_201608 V1.05
shadow.method: Crop one 60 m pixel on each side, count shadow-flagged pixels in each 8×8 block; unrecognized DN=0 propagates unknown.

ice.meaning: Cold-trap screening threshold, independent of ice detection or concentration
ice.observation: LCROSS Centaur ejecta at Cabeus; point evidence only
